definitions: A missile that follows a ballistic trajectory with the objective of delivering one or more warheads to a predetermined target.
A rocket-powered missile that is guided during the powered phase of flight and then follows an unpowered, free-falling trajectory to its target.
examples: The country tested a new ballistic missile.
Concerns were raised about the development of a long-range ballistic missile.
A ballistic missile can carry various types of warheads.
